topic: official free claude skill that makes ai-built websites stop looking generic
hook: AI websites all look the same? Not with this free Claude skill.
caption:
Comment DESIGN and I'll DM you the link and the install steps. Follow first so the DM reaches you.

You can spot an AI-built website from across the room. Purple gradient. Inter font. 3 cards in a row.

This free Claude skill from Anthropic tells Claude to pick a bold direction before it writes any code, and it lists those tired looks as things to avoid. I asked it for a site for a made-up roofer in Denver and got something that looked built for roofers, not for a pitch deck.

#aitools #artificialintelligence #claudeai #codingtips #claudecode
